name: navigation-read
description: Read the Tradebee two-level navigation tree without pagination.

language.description: Required exact enabled site language selected from languages-get. Results are restricted to this language.

navigation_id.description: Optional positive navigation ID for one exact item. Omit it to avoid ID filtering. It cannot be combined with parent_navigation_id.

parent_navigation_id.description: Optional parent filter. Use 0 for first-level navigation or a positive first-level ID for its children. It cannot be combined with navigation_id.

fields.description: Optional fields to return. Omit it or send [] for all supported fields. The content field is first-level custom child-navigation HTML and is empty for system children, manual-child containers, and second-level items. The sort field ranges from 1 to 999999, with smaller values appearing earlier. When system_children_type is returned: 0 disables system children; 1 first-level product groups; 2 news groups; 3 FAQ groups; 4 certificate groups; 5 case groups; 6 all product groups without cover images; 7 blog groups. Do not send pagination parameters.

output.description: API result with data.list ordered by sort ascending, so smaller sort values appear earlier; first-level items contain children and all second-level children arrays are empty.
